# Audette IT — full site content

> Everything on audetteit.com in one file, for AI agents and anyone who wants plain text. The site is currently a single maintenance page; the HTML page is the canonical version.

## How this site serves Markdown

- The homepage has a Markdown twin at `/index.md`.
- Requesting `/` with `Accept: text/markdown` returns the same Markdown with `Content-Type: text/markdown`. Those responses send `Vary: Accept` and a `Link: <https://audetteit.com/>; rel="canonical"` header.
- Index: https://audetteit.com/llms.txt
- XML sitemap: https://audetteit.com/sitemap.xml
